notes.title: Development status
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44793363/5edb5ecacb180cc0ae9639ffedc55c16ed67670e.png[/img]

Hello, I'm jipoiz

It's been quite a while since the last update of the demo version

We would like to leave a simple development status.

"JIPOIZ" is a one-man development game that uses leisure time after work to work within 1-2 hours

It sounds like an excuse, but I'm not working full-time, so I'm very slow to work

I always feel sorry for the users who are waiting.

Re-creating more than half of the game with a structure bug

Multiplayer is full of bugs

I didn't like the effects, UI, and animation, so I changed it

I want to break the head of Radan, the king of the promise

There are so many reasons why the development period is so long

Anyway, we are continuing to work steadily.

Once you've dealt with some of the important issues in front of you

I will update the demo version again.

Thank you.
